about_the_game:
Optasia: The Last Visit is a surreal, narrative-driven experience.

The asylum is not what it seems. Memory fragments surface — family letters, tapes, drawings — and subtle contradictions build a picture of something long buried.

This is not a game of jump scares, but of atmosphere, melancholy, and unease. The story unfolds through exploration, environmental storytelling, and narration from your older self questioning the past.
